_README: ManduVPN RC: plan definition for `php artisan manduvpn:plan-data`.
Copy this file, fill in the REAL prices and group ids, then:
php artisan manduvpn:plan-data validate --file=storage/app/manduvpn-plans.json
php artisan manduvpn:plan-data seed     --file=storage/app/manduvpn-plans.json            (dry run)
php artisan manduvpn:plan-data seed     --file=storage/app/manduvpn-plans.json --apply    (Owner approval)
php artisan manduvpn:plan-data cutover --apply                                            (atomic switch-on)
UNITS - the single most common accident on this codebase:
prices     = CNY in YUAN. PlanResource and OrderController multiply it by 100 to get fen.
prices_krw = KRW in WON, stored exactly as written. No conversion, no FX.
The two are INDEPENDENT list prices. Never derive one from the other.
RULES the validator enforces, so read them before editing:
- service_tier must be legacy|basic|pro|master|vip. A plan NAME never implies a tier.
- device_limit must be UNIQUE within one (audience, service_tier): it is the purchase-UI selector axis.
- every partner row needs a public row with the SAME service_tier and device_limit, or partners see both.
- every period that has a prices_krw entry must also have a prices entry, because
PlanService::validatePurchase() requires a CNY price regardless of order currency (RC_BACKEND.md OD-1).
- a legacy plan's group_id must contain at least one node with type=ikev2, show=1, parent_id IS NULL,
or BasicServerAssignmentService 422-fails every purchase.
The values below are PLACEHOLDERS covering only days_30 and days_360 for one tier pair.
Real amounts, the full 12-period lineup and the group ids are an Owner decision (RC_BACKEND.md OD-2).
Rows are always seeded show=0 sell=0; nothing becomes visible until `cutover`.
